title: Audio player: transport, volume and waveform scrubber
description: Replace the bare Electron <audio> playback with a real player - play/pause, an MPI volume slider with mute, elapsed/total time, and the MPI-730 waveform as its scrub track. Mostly reuse: MpiVideoControlBar already owns this exact transport (MpiButton play/pause, volumeHigh/volumeOff mute, MpiProgressBar volume, time display) against MpiVideoSurface. The audio one swaps the embedded MpiTrimBar for MpiWaveform and the surface for an <audio> element.
